lines.t: Used to run around this small town street
Looking for a peace I couldn't reach
Tried to fill the void with the world's desire
Just end up standing in the ash and fire
Then You met me right where I fell down
Turned my whole life right side out
Now I'm chasin' You like a river to the sea
Every single day, Lord, You're calling me
Chasin' You past the shadow and the doubt
Knowing what Your love is all about
Chasin' that mercy, chasin' that grace
Looking for the light upon Your face
Yeah, I used to run from the truth I knew
Now every step I take, I'm chasin' You
Still chasin' You
I spent a lot of time on a dead-end road
Trying to carry every heavy load
Thought I had to make it on my own strength
Going to any length
Till I heard Your voice calling out my name
Breaking right through my grief and pain
Now I'm chasin' You like a river to the sea
Every single day, Lord, You're calling me
Chasin' You past the shadow and the doubt
Knowing what Your love is all about
Chasin' that mercy, chasin' that grace
Looking for the light upon Your face
Yeah, I used to run from the truth I knew
Now every step I take, I'm chasin' You
Still chasin' You
Yeah, I'm chasin' You
Every single day, Lord
Still chasin' You
